messages:
arjun: Heads-up: NIC firmware vendor released a minor fix for RX queue stalls observed at high fan-in. Planning a soft-drain + staged NIC micro-reboot for eu-west2 edge racks. Window: Fri 2026-04-09 01:00-03:30 UTC. Expect brief DMA reset per host (1-3m), rolling by rack.

hannah: Affected pools? Any Dedicated customers impacted?

arjun: Target: eu-edge-pool-alpha (burst & shared). Dedicated-reserved pools excluded unless we see spillover. We'll float spare capacity from eu-central if needed.

marta: Past incidents showed p50 stable but p99 spike on embeddings during cold KV re-pop. Can we prepopulate caches?

dar: (diego): Plan: run kvpop on warm standbys 45m prior; use kvpop concurrency 6 to avoid IO storms. Also enable prefix-cache warmup for 1h.

hannah: Add a small canary in us-central to validate NIC reboot sequence before changing EU fleet. Canary: 3 hosts. Abort threshold: packet-drop > 0.2% or outbound latency p95 increase > 150ms.

ops-bot: maintenance ticket created: MO-2405  https://redwood.atlassian/issue/MO-2405

arjun: Preflight checklist snippet:
```bash
# pre-seed KV
python infra/kvpop.py --pool eu-edge-pool-alpha --concurrency 6 --duration 2700
# cap autoscaler
kubectl patch hpa cluster-autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"maxSurge":0.15}}'
```

marta: Important: DO NOT set maxSurge=0.0. Full autoscaler suspension last time forced >200 tenants to hosted fallback. 15% cap is safer.

hannah: Routing policy during window: latency-sensitive tenants -> eu-central; best-effort -> us-west fallback. Ramon (network) please confirm BGP communities for preferring eu-central.

dar: (diego) Ramon out today, pinging netops. I have a fallback script to adjust route communities if needed.

finance-bot: Quick estimate: if 120k tokens shift to hosted at $0.0115/token => ~ $1,380. This is a ballpark.

hannah: Customer advisory draft: "We
re performing planned NIC micro-reboots in eu-west2 on Fri 2026-04-09 01:00-03:30 UTC. Minimal disruption expected. Edge burst pools may be routed to regional capacity. Contact support for SLA impact." Approve?

marta: approve with one edit: include that Dedicated-reserved pools are not expected to be affected.

dar: Timeline (tentative):
- 00:15 pre-seed KV on standbys
- 00:55 trigger us-central canary (3 hosts)
- 01:15 validate canary + 15m buffer
- 01:30 begin eu-west2 rack-by-rack soft-drains (10m per rack, overlapping by 2 racks)
- 03:15 final verification
- 03:30 close window
Whoovers oncall?

arjun: Oncall: hannah, marta. Diego leads rollout ops. Finance on standby: @finance-bot. I'll monitor telemetry and queue drops.

hannah: Rollback playbook (short):
```text
if packet_drop_rate > 0.2% or p95_latency_up > 150ms:
  - pause rollout
  - re-inject drained nodes
  - re-route traffic to eu-central
  - open priority incident and escalate
```

marta: Also mute long-running evals and heavy quantization jobs during the window. We'll add a synthetic suppression tag so alerts don't fire on warmups.

dar: I'll add a throttled kvpop to avoid overloading NVMe.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: MO-2405 will start Fri 2026-04-09 01:00 UTC. Canary automation set for 75 minutes beforehand.

hannah: All good. I'll send customer advisory and lock autoscaler maxSurge to 15% at T-30m. :white_check_mark:
